shared_elements: curved and linear incised or painted marks
roughly horizontal banding of motifs across the surface
justification: Both are weathered stone surfaces bearing reddish-brown motifs arranged in loosely horizontal registers, and both include at least one closed circular/ring element among curving lines. But A is a flat rock face with flat painted, schematic multi-limbed figures in repeated rows, while B is a three-dimensional carved monolith whose ornament is low-relief, abstract and wrapped around a sculpted body — the technique, format and subject matter are fundamentally different.
